build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with parameterized balls, bars, and walls using define_task_template decorator
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the PHYRE scene with specified scale and position
add_static_bar: add a static bar to the PHYRE scene with configurable angle, scale, and position
update_task_relationship: update the PHYRE task to define a TOUCHING spatial relationship between two bodies
set_solution_meta: set the PHYRE task metadata to specify the BALL solution tier
